The '''Corellian Engineering Corporation Research, Development and Engineering Center''' was a scientific organization working for the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].

==History==
It worked on Corellian starship designs and improved on existing ones, including the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. It also occasionally worked with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and had its designs/products approved by Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]].
